summary: Lower a class static initialization block through explicit class-evaluation code while preserving block scope, private access, and synchronous execution.

target.notes: Execute the lowered block inside the generated class-initialization routine at class evaluation time with access to the class's private state.

caveats: If the block uses constructor-object `this`, dynamic super property access, or other reflective behavior, the generated initializer must use the runtime class-object representation.

tests.name: block mutates static state
tests.input: class C { static x=1; static { this.x=2; } } console.log(C.x);

tests.name: edge: var does not leak
tests.input: var x='outer'; class C { static { var x='inner'; } } console.log(x);
